title: Introducing Citizen Leader
author: Kathleen Schafer
summary: Schafer introduces her new book, Citizen Leader, which explores the foundations of soulful leadership and how ordinary people can become transformational leaders in their communities. The work emphasizes the integration of personal identity, values, and purpose in developing authentic leadership capabilities. Through interviews and conversations, particularly with co-founder Alyson Sattler, Schafer articulates a vision of leadership rooted in understanding, compassion, and civic engagement. The Citizen Leader framework positions leadership not as a professional credential or elite capability, but as an inherent capacity within all people to create meaningful change. The book draws from Schafer's work at the Center for Understanding and offers practical wisdom for those seeking to expand their influence and impact.
points: Leadership is not an elite credential but an inherent capacity within all people to create meaningful change.
The Citizen Leader framework integrates personal identity, values, and authentic purpose.
Soulful leadership requires understanding, compassion, and civic engagement.
Ordinary individuals can become transformational leaders in their communities through intentional practice.
